ladder.classBlurb: The Paladin swears an oath that reaches past the veil, guarding the lost and hidden from what lurks in fog.
The Paladin carries Heaven's mercy and Hell's justice, judging foes and protecting the innocent.
The Paladin holds their oath even as the world falls apart, an unbreaking will in a shifting world.
The Paladin becomes a light in the deep, their aura a wall the darkness cannot cross.
The Paladin's oath becomes part of their heart, a living vow that grows stronger with every life saved.
The Paladin's banner rises across worlds, rallying knights from many planes to a single cause.
The Paladin keeps their oath even in nothingness, a vow that exists without witness or reward.
The Paladin swears oaths so deep they need no words, guarding things the world has forgotten.
The Paladin embodies the first promise of the world, the vow that came before any god's contract.

subclasses.ds: A paladin sworn to scorched earth rather than mercy, smiting with fire that lingers as cinders.
Paladins who seek to crush chaos with fear and iron will. (Xanathar's Guide to Everything)
The classic paladin ideal — honesty, courage, and protecting the weak, backed by radiant power that scales into a genuine holy champion.
A paladin sworn to outlast rather than to strike first, refusing to fall even at 0 hit points.
Paladins who pursue heroic deeds and legend. (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything)
Paladins who seek peace and redemption before violence. (Xanathar's Guide to Everything)
A paladin sworn to a quiet, unseen justice, striking without sound or opportunity attack.
Paladins sworn to punish those who have committed grievous sins. (Player's Handbook)
Paladins sworn to preserve life, light, and joy in the world. (Player's Handbook)
Paladins sworn to law, society, and sovereign. (Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide)
Guardians against extraplanar threats. (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything)
Paladins who broke their oath and turned to darker ambitions. The DMG presents it as a villain option; DM approval recommended. (Dungeon Master's Guide)
A paladin who has broken their sacred oath and found power in that very act of betrayal.

ladder.classBlurb: The Ranger learns to follow trails through the mist and veil, hunting prey that leaves no physical sign.
The Ranger hunts demons and fallen angels alike, wardens of the borders between Heaven and Hell.
The Ranger reads the shifting paths of chaos, finding the way through mazes that rewrite themselves.
The Ranger hunts the deep places of the world, laying snares for monsters that never see light.
The Ranger becomes master of the oldest forests, commanding beasts that remember every hunter before them.
The Ranger rides across horizons, scouting worlds and hunting creatures from beyond the stars.
The Ranger learns to walk and hunt through nothing, leaving no trace and making no sound.
The Ranger becomes a hunter the world forgets, stalking prey that does not know it is hunted.
The Ranger hunts the oldest beasts of the world, those born before the Laws of nature were written.

subclasses.ds: A ranger who leads a pack rather than a single companion, coordinating strikes between two bonded beasts at once.
Rangers who bond with a beast companion. (Player's Handbook)
Rangers bonded to a young drake companion. (Fizban's Treasury of Dragons)
Rangers marked by the Feywild — charming, mobile, and unsettling. (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything)
Rangers who hunt in darkness and strike first. (Xanathar's Guide to Everything)
Rangers who guard the boundaries between planes. (Xanathar's Guide to Everything)
The straightforward combat ranger — a menu of tactical options against different threats (single strong enemies, groups of weak enemies, and everything between).
Hunters of supernatural threats. (Xanathar's Guide to Everything)
A ranger who tracks best under moonlight, close kin to old werewolf-hunter lore, striking hardest at shapechangers.
Rangers bonded to a swarm of nature spirits. (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything)
A ranger who has merged with the thorned and dangerous aspects of nature, becoming one with the defensive violence of the wild.
A ranger who hunts things that came from the Void rather than the Mortal Realm, seeing what shouldn't be visible.

ladder.classBlurb: The Rogue slips through fog and mirror alike, a thief who vanishes like mist.
The Rogue moves contraband between Heaven and Hell, slipping past angels and devils alike.
The Rogue cheats fate itself, slipping extra luck into every roll.
The Rogue learns to move through the absolute dark of the deep, unseen by eyes that have never seen light.
The Rogue learns to steal from within, picking locks on memory, heart and soul.
The Rogue cons whole worlds, slipping across horizons and leaving chaos behind.
The Rogue steals with hands made of nothing, taking what no lock or ward can hold.
The Rogue becomes so forgettable they may never have existed, slipping out of the world's memory.
The Rogue steals from the beginning of the world, taking powers that should belong to no mortal.

subclasses.ds: Rogues who add illusion and enchantment magic to their tricks. (Player's Handbook)
Rogues who specialize in killing quickly and quietly. (Player's Handbook)
A rogue who uses their own blood as a weapon, painting battlefields red with calculated sacrifice.
Rogues who root out secrets and lies. (Xanathar's Guide to Everything)
Rogues who play the game of intrigue and command from the back line. (Xanathar's Guide to Everything)
A rogue who moves through shadow rather than crowds, teleporting between patches of darkness to strike unseen.
Rogues who walk alongside death and its spirits. (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything)
Skirmishers and outdoor experts. (Xanathar's Guide to Everything)
A rogue who treats shadow as a second set of streets, moving between dim patches unseen and untracked.
A rogue trained in the arts of spiritual theft — stealing not just gold but memories, skills, and life force.

Soul Thief expands the fantasy and gameplay style of the Rogue class.
 This subclass focuses on a unique identity, combat role, and spell progression.
Rogues who manifest psychic blades. (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything)
Dashing duelists who rely on charm and speed. (Xanathar's Guide to Everything)
The generalist rogue — better at using items, moving through the world, and staying hidden than any other rogue archetype.
